item.title: Former Ranji Trophy cricketer from Mizoram dies after collapsing during match
item.description: Former Ranji Trophy cricketer from Mizoram, K Lalremruata, passed away on Wednesday after collapsing during a local cricket match. His death has sent shockwaves in the Mizoram cricket community and all the scheduled matches in the state have been cancelled as a mark of respect.

item.title: Jana Nayagan: Madras High Court clears Thalapathy Vijay's film, directs CBFC to issue UA certificate
item.description: Jana Nayagan: The Madras High Court has cleared the plea filed by the makers of Thalapathy Vijay's film against the delay in certification. The court directed the Central Board of Film Certification to issue a “UA” certificate forthwith.
